content.title: Open a savings account online
content.description: A prospective customer opens a savings account on the web through a four-step wizard that starts on Account type, moves through About you, Fund it, and Review, keeps the current step visible and completed steps checked, allows back-navigation from step two onward, and only lets the applicant leave the identity step when required personal and contact details are present and correctly formed; in this demo scope the flow ends at “Open account” without real KYC, credit checks, money movement, or session persistence between visits.
content.summary: Open a savings account through the web wizard.
content.value: Acquires savings-account applications without a branch visit while screening out obviously invalid applicant data before downstream verification.
criteria: the onboarding wizard shows four steps in this order: Account type, About you, Fund it, and Review
the primary action reads "Continue →" on the first three steps and "Open account" on the final step, and a "← Back" control is available from step two onward
the stepper marks the current step and shows completed steps with a check
the Account type step is active on first load and advances to About you when the user continues with a selected product
attempting to continue from About you with empty fields keeps the user on About you and shows inline validation errors
required identity fields are first name, last name, street address, city, and state
email must be well-formed, and malformed email such as `notanemail` shows the message "Enter a valid email"
phone must contain at least 10 digits, SSN accepts exactly the last 4 digits, and ZIP must be exactly 5 digits
